steps.content: Since the interrogation, you have been waiting to see what Ayiguo does next.
Strangely, the past few days have passed in utter quiet. There is no sign of action. You do not spot so much as a single insect. Rather than putting you at ease, the silence only deepens your unease.
As if to confirm your premonition, a knock comes at your office door.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief. Sinner Ayiguo left her supervised zone three minutes ago.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How did she get out? Reason?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Method of departure unconfirmed. Security doors are intact. No alarms were triggered. Internal surveillance shows 3.7 seconds of anomalous interference. After that window, she was gone.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Her motive remains unclear, but the bio-monitoring system flagged an unusually high-frequency bioelectricity resonance signal.

You set up this system specifically to monitor the insects surrounding Ayiguo. After days of observation, you confirm that these spiders and crawling vermin lack any intelligence of their own. They merely follow Ayiguo's will.
Yet it is less a command and more a shared consciousness with Ayiguo. She controls them without a single physical gesture.
You have never seen anything like this. It bears no resemblance to a Mania-induced mutation. Rather, it appears to be... some mysterious power from Eastia.
Under Nightingale's control, the system decodes the signal and converts it to audio.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: ...Intel's solid, I'm telling you. Underground auction, Eastside. Star item... you've ever heard of "Genesis Powder"? Old Eastian secret recipe. The rumors are wild. Some say it can bring dead wood back to bloom... Starting bid's through the roof.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: But word from the inside says it's bad news. No known source, no ingredient list. It's flagged as high-risk contraband... Me? Hard pass. Way too creepy for my taste.
The noise-reduced dialogue comes through with perfect clarity. It is Faye's voice, and what you hear is shocking. You take the terminal, your heart sinking.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Her insects caught this conversation. She's after the powder.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That's the assessment, yes. She also left this behind.
Nightingale hands you a note. The handwriting is crooked and uneven, as if a spider has just crawled across the page. It bears only a single cryptic sentence:
Going to buy some cosmetics. Be back soon!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Should I organize a pursuit team?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No. Her temperament is unstable, and her methods are unpredictable. A rushed grab in public could escalate into a city-wide incident.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She left those breadcrumbs for a reason. She wants me to follow. Prep a vehicle. We're heading to Eastside.
You stand up and grab your coat from the chair.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: One more thing, contact Banyan Medical College. Tell them I need her physical examination results the moment the analysis is complete.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Notify the Public Security Bureau. I want a discreet perimeter around the auction venue, but no visible presence.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Until we know what she's actually after, she doesn't get within arm's reach of that Genesis Powder. An unevaluated high-risk item in her possession is not an option.
(Scene change)

Afternoon
Eastside Underground Auction

Through a secret door disguised as an embossed wall, you ascend a spiral staircase carpeted in deep purple velvet. You obtained the auction's address and invitation by threatening Faye, and now you put on the mask the venue provides.
At the top of the staircase lies a circular hall with soaring ceilings. Guests are seated in small clusters, giving the scene the appearance of an ordinary business reception.

Your arrival draws little attention. Once you settle onto a corner sofa, you quickly spot a figure in the VIP section diagonally opposite—Ayiguo. She is not wearing a mask, and her Eastian attire stands out brazenly among the crowd.

steps.speaker: Guest 1
steps.content: What's the story with that Outland girl? Three bids in, and suddenly nobody wants to raise a paddle.

steps.speaker: Guest 2
steps.content: No clue, but she must be connected. Look, she hasn't touched a single other lot all afternoon. Only has eyes for the Genesis Powder.

steps.speaker: Guest 1
steps.content: So the powder's legit, then? Some kind of Eastian miracle cure? Damn. Should've thrown in when I had the chance...

steps.speaker: Guest 2
steps.content: Shh... Keep your voice down. You didn't see? The guy bidding against her went white as a sheet and bolted. Staff didn't say a word. When's the last time a finale item closed in three rounds? She's got juice. The kind that makes auction houses nervous.
According to what those two just said, Ayiguo has already secured the Genesis Powder.

You rise and approach her, betraying no emotion. Dozens of nearly invisible black specks are crawling out from the collars and cuffs of other guests, quietly making their way back into her sleeves. To your surprise, Ayiguo seems to sense your presence. She stands gracefully to greet you and raises her glass in salute.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: My, my. Granny doesn't recall raising such a clingy little pest. Tsk, tsk. And here I thought you'd learned to behave.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Impressive resources you've got. If you can afford to bid like that, why bother using insects to scare off the competition?

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Save when you should, spend when you must. I didn't rob anyone blind, and that's me being polite, little one. If something caught your eye, just say so. Make this granny smile, and perhaps I'll buy it for you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You left supervision. That violates the terms we set. Walk away now, and we can still settle this quietly.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Threatening this granny? How unseemly. Didn't I leave you a perfectly lovely note?

Though the auction has ended, many people linger to chat and mingle. Unwilling to cause a scene, you decide to play along with Ayiguo's banter and wait for an opportunity to persuade her to return to the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your abilities are too volatile. I can't let you wander Eastside unchecked. Come back to the Bureau before this gets worse.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Tch. There's an old Eastian saying, child. "Sending a god away is hard. Inviting one? Even harder." Do you know why?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Isn't it "inviting a god is easy but sending one away is hard"? Anyway, what's your point?

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Because... gods don't take orders. I came all this way. I'm not leaving with nothing but a scolding.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: You didn't come alone, did you? All those little shadows outside... are they here to escort this granny home? Or drag her?
Ayiguo sees right through your plan, yet she gives nothing away. Instead, she patiently engages you in this verbal dance. She is waiting for something.

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: Your item, ma'am.
She is waiting for the Genesis Powder.

The attendant appears at precisely this moment. Your gaze and hers fall upon the velvet tray at once. A transparent crystal bottle holds a strange greenish-purple liquid, black specks roiling inside like bubbles.
Ayiguo reaches for it. You move first, pressing your hand down on the edge of the tray.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This item needs inspection first.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: What?! On what grounds? This granny paid good money for that!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's not a request. Unknown hazardous materials require inspection and registration by the technical department.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Dangerous, my spider leg! There isn't a poison in this world more dangerous than this granny herself! Now hand it over!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're standing on DisCity soil. You're on the MBCC roster. That means MBCC rules. Now tell me, what exactly do you intend to do with this?
Beads of sweat now dot Ayiguo's forehead, her brows drawn tightly together. Her tone turns agitated, simmering with frustration.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: What do I want? I want to live! I came to you for the shackles, and you refused. I try to find my own remedy, and you block that too. You're leaving me no road to walk!

With a violent swat, she knocks your hand away and lunges for the crystal bottle. But you have already moved. You push the attendant aside and seize the entire tray. Ayiguo's hand closes on empty air.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We can find a solution, but not with something unvetted. Not like this.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Hah! Easy words from someone who isn't rotting from the inside out. If there were another way, do you think this granny would've spent decades swallowing poison just to survive?
She lunges forward without warning, her poisonous breath coming close enough to graze your face.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: I see you now. Clear as glass. You're just another coward wearing honest skin. All those pretty words about trust and cooperation... Spare me. You're afraid my poison will stain your precious Eastside. Afraid this mad old dog will bite your reputation to shreds!

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Listen well. I'm taking that Genesis Powder. You won't save me? Fine. I'll save myself! This granny has been beautiful her whole long life, and I refuse to rot away in your little city!

Following Ayiguo's threats, commotion erupts in the corners of the auction hall. Just as at the Bureau earlier, swarms of snakes, insects, rats, and ants pour in. Guests scream and scatter in all directions.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Can't get your way, so you throw a tantrum? That's cheap.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Why should I play fair in your city? Nobody here knows this granny anyway!
A thin snake coiled on the chandelier suddenly drops like a black bolt of lightning, striking precisely toward the crystal bottle in your hand.
You react without hesitation, raising your hand to release your shackles. The snake is blasted backward, its tail falling limp as the crystal bottle slips from your grasp and flies into the air.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Mine!!
Almost simultaneously, you both leap into the air. Your goal is to intercept the crystal bottle, while Ayiguo lunges desperately to seize it. Your fingertips cross in mid-air.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Enough.
You hold the height advantage and reach the bottle first.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Let go! You're stealing from me and acting righteous about it?! Give it here!

The force of your struggle pops the stopper off with a sharp crack. Viscous, dark green liquid tinged with purple spills through the air. By sheer coincidence, most of it pours directly into a wine glass Ayiguo has somehow grabbed with her other hand.
Hiss—
The poison mixes with the strong liquor and releases a bubbling, corrosive sound. You and Ayiguo both freeze, staring at the strange liquid roiling in the glass.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Fine then... this way's faster.
Before you can stop her, she tilts her head back and drains the glass in one swift gulp, swallowing the entire mixture of poison and liquor. A triumphant laugh slips from her lips.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Haha! You little brat, think you can outsmart this granny? You're still far from—

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: Urgh—! Ahhh—!!
Her laughter cuts off without warning, transforming into agonized shrieks.
She doubles over violently, hands clawing desperately at her throat, as though something is tearing her apart from within.

Her once fair, smooth face is instantly covered in deep wrinkles, like ravines carved into stone. Greenish-blue veins bulge violently along the side of her neck and spread like a spider web across half her face. Insect-shaped shadows writhe beneath the skin, then break through to the surface, crawling across her face in a truly horrifying sight.
You quickly remove your coat, meaning to cover Ayiguo, but she dodges out of reach.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: My face... What's happening to my face?!
In the reflection of the glass display case, Ayiguo sees her face. One half remains youthful; the other is a horrifying visage, aging rapidly before her eyes.

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: AAAAHHHHH!!!

Her shriek detonates chaos. Black ripples of Mania explode outward with her at the epicenter, and the hall's M-value skyrockets in an instant. The auction house transforms into a toxic den as guests scream and flee in blind panic.

You push through the lethal poison and Mania contamination, trying to close the distance, but the swarm reacts faster. Spiders pour from Ayiguo's body in all directions, spewing venom-laced silk that weaves itself into a massive web glowing with an eerie green light. Within moments, it envelops the entire hall and wraps Ayiguo in countless layers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eugene, move in with Public Security. Full evacuation. Lock down every block surrounding this location!
At the center of the web, an ominous cocoon is already taking shape with alarming speed.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Copy that! Backup's en route. Poison specialists are being scrambled. Chief, keep yourself breathing until they arrive!
Your terminal vibrates. The report from Banyan Medical College comes through. You scroll through the screen without hesitation—

...The subject's physiological age is estimated to be 100 years or older. Over one hundred distinct toxic compounds coexist within her body. It is presumed that she has long consumed exotic poisons, relying on the mutual balance among these toxins to sustain her vital functions... ...An unknown venomous agent has been detected within the subject. This toxin is not parasitic but rather an inherent component of her biological makeup... The subject displays extraordinary resilience. Her survival to the present day is nothing short of miraculous. Current medical science offers no means of intervening in her condition. WARNING: Any external intervention risks disrupting the existing equilibrium, leading to complete systemic collapse...
You scroll to the end, where the special notation section glares in red:
DO NOT make direct contact. She IS the poison itself.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: This old body's soaked in poison, you foolish brat! Do you have a death wish?!
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Ayiguo
steps.content: What do I want? I want to live! I came to you for the shackles, and you refused. I try to find my own remedy, and you block that too. You're leaving me no road to walk!
(Scene change)

You approach the massive cocoon. Muffled, inhuman whimpers emanate from somewhere deep within. The venomous silk continues to thicken as the runaway Mania and toxins are forcibly contained inside. The immense energy building within stretches the silk cocoon until it becomes nearly translucent.
Even before losing consciousness, she was instinctively containing the damage.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ayiguo? Can you hear me?
The insects around you begin to converge toward the cocoon. A small spider drops from your body, pushes aside the dense venomous silk, and crawls toward Ayiguo.
Is that Seven? Or Eight? Who knows when she planted yet another spider on you?

Could it be that she knew you would come all along, yet she still waited here, risking capture. Her condition must be far graver than you imagine, grave enough that she has to take that poison without delay.
<color=#fb9259>Whether in Eastia or DisCity, everything she has ever done is to survive.</color>
You sink into thought. Through the comms, Eugene's anxious voice pulls you back to the present.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief! Toxin concentration at the venue is 700% over the limit! You need to evacuate, now!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief! You must—

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Notify the perimeter. Expand the evacuation zone. Ten kilometers, minimum. Toxin specialists and security team in maximum-grade hazmat. Contain the spread of poison and Mania. Clean what you can.
You pause for a brief second, then speak into the terminal with a renewed sense of resolve.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm going in.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: What?! Chief, the concentration inside that cocoon—

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She's my Sinner.
You press your hand against the wall of the cocoon. It feels alive beneath your touch, a faint pulse throbbing steadily under your palm.

Your mind drifts back to the tense standoff in the interrogation room. She was already at the end of her strength back then; all that pain and desperation were genuine. Even though you know she cannot hear you from inside, you lean in closer to the cocoon.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You couldn't wait any longer. Why didn't you say something back then? What happened to you... that made trusting anyone this impossible?
You have missed the best chance to help her. You will not let a second one slip away.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you won't tell me yourself, then I'll see it with my own eyes.

Static crackles across the comms before the Mania cuts the line entirely. The poison threads sense your touch and part in silence, revealing a narrow opening. Just as you have done countless times before, you step into the massive cocoon and enter the Mania without hesitation.

Eerie purple mist drags you forward, and in an instant, the world shifts. You find yourself back at the Bureau, but it's now empty and cold. Then the walls begin to writhe. Flesh-like growths sprout across their surface and split open with violent force. Countless eyes pour forth from the wounds, watching.

A corrosive pain sears from your nose through your chest, the only anchor keeping you remotely rational. The illusion twists and crumbles around you as roiling darkness and toxic miasma close in. Lost and alone, you cling to consciousness through endless poison and pain, relying on even stronger toxins to suppress the agony. A cycle with no escape, repeating forever.
Is this what Ayiguo endures in every single moment of her century-long existence? Your senses abandon you entirely. Through sheer willpower alone, you stretch out your hand and reach forward.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ayiguo.
Your voice turns hoarse in the toxic miasma. Poison marks bloom on your arms, just like hers. You hold no fear for Mania, but you are far from immune to every toxin.
No response. Yet the poison threads around you tremble, faint. You endure the agony of toxins seeping into your body. You push through the Mania's turbulence. You keep reaching—
Until your hand touches something.
In a single instant, all darkness and all pain dissolve into nothing. You stand at the center of a lake.
